name: mermaid
description: Draws ```mermaid blocks of a reply under the reply, or in a pane live as it streams (lovely-mermaid)

placement.title: Where diagrams show
placement.description: inline: every finished diagram under the reply that holds it. pane (auto-open): the latest diagram in the Mermaid pane, which opens by itself when a reply streams one. pane (/mermaid): the same pane, opened only with /mermaid. /mermaid opens the pane in every mode. All follow View: text or image.

view.title: View
view.description: text: Unicode box art. image: a PNG made by mermaid-cli (mmdc), drawn with the kitty graphics protocol; box art while the diagram streams. The pane button switches for the session, inline diagrams too.

mmdc.title: mermaid-cli command
mmdc.description: The mmdc executable for image view (npm i -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli).

density.title: Image density
density.description: PNG pixels per terminal column (mmdc draws at scale 2). Lower: bigger diagrams; higher: smaller. A diagram never grows past the pane's width.

autoSwitch.title: Image theme: auto switch
autoSwitch.description: on: the light or dark theme below, as Claude Code's theme says; when that is auto, as macOS's appearance is. off: always Image theme.

lightTheme.title: Image light theme
lightTheme.description: The mermaid theme for light appearance, when auto switch is on.

darkTheme.title: Image dark theme
darkTheme.description: The mermaid theme for dark appearance, when auto switch is on.

theme.title: Image theme
theme.description: The mermaid theme, when auto switch is off.
